usage.callShape: POST https://api.exa.ai/search with JSON body {query, numResults}
usage.outputShape: body.results[].url and body.results[].title; optionally publishedDate, image, favicon per result; body.costDollars.total for actual cost
quirks: Default results include only url/title/id — pass contents:{text:true} or contents:{summary:true} in the request body to retrieve page text or summaries
numResults is capped at 10 for x402 tier per the schema description
body.resolvedSearchType may be an empty string even on success
usage.guide: POST to https://api.exa.ai/search with a JSON body containing at minimum {query}. Optionally pass numResults (max 10 on x402), type ('neural', 'keyword', 'auto', etc.), and a contents object ({text:true} or {summary:true}) to get page body in results. Payment of $0.007 USDC is deducted per call on Base via x402 — no upstream API key is needed. Results are returned synchronously in body.results[] with url, title, and optional metadata.
